aa-typical-5083.title: Aluminum Association typical physical values for 5083 (typical, not guaranteed)
aa-typical-5083.reference: Atlas Steels Aluminium Alloy 5083 data sheet (rev. 24 Jun 2021), citing Aluminium Association Standards and Data 2009 Metric SI: density 2660, E 71 GPa, expansion 23.8e-6/K (20-100 C), conductivity 117 W/mK; density, expansion and conductivity cross-checked on Compraco's 5083-O table, which also gives specific heat 899 J/kgK

materials.name: Aluminium 6061-T6
materials.notes: General machining alloy. Yield 240 and tensile 260 MPa are SPECIFICATION MINIMUMS (extrusion and bar; sheet and plate guarantee 240 / 290), not the ASM typical 276 / 310 MPa, which the Aluminum Association marks not for design (ASTM B209M-14 table 3, Aluminum Association table 11.1, EN 755-2; checked 19 Nov 2026). Physical values are ASM typical. No shear strength is listed: no specification guarantees one. Plate is usually T651 with the same minimums. The Poisson ratio is an ASM estimate.

materials.name: Aluminium 7075-T6
materials.notes: High-strength alloy. Yield 460 and tensile 540 MPa are SPECIFICATION MINIMUMS (plate 6.3-12.5 mm, unclad, ASTM B209M-14 table 3 and EN 485-2), not the ASM typical 503 / 572 MPa. Thicker plate (25-50 mm) guarantees 530 tensile, thin sheet under 0.32 mm guarantees 435 yield, clad sheet is lower. Physical values are ASM typical. No shear strength is listed. The Poisson ratio is an ASM estimate.

materials.name: Aluminium 5083-H111
materials.designation: Aluminium alloy 5083 (EN AW-5083, AlMg4.5Mn0.7), temper H111, sheet and plate
materials.notes: Marine and welding alloy, not heat treatable. Yield 115 and tensile 270 MPa are SPECIFICATION MINIMUMS for O/H111 sheet and plate up to 80 mm (EN 485-2 6.3-80 mm band; ASTM B209M 5083-O gives the same at 40-80 mm), so they hold for any thickness up to 80 mm. Thin sheet 0.2-6.3 mm guarantees 125 / 275 MPa; 80-120 mm plate only 110 / 260. Typical values are higher (about 145 / 300 MPa on a mill sheet). Physical values are Aluminum Association typical; specific heat is the Compraco 5083-O value. The Poisson ratio 0.33 is the typical wrought 5xxx value (Matmatch, Alloys International), not from the AA table. No shear strength is listed: no specification guarantees one. Not for use above 65 C (stress corrosion).

materials.name: Steel S235JR
materials.designation: Structural steel S235JR (EN 10025-2), hot rolled, thickness up to 16 mm
materials.notes: EN 10025-2 minimums: yield 235 MPa up to 16 mm thick (lower for thicker sections: 225 MPa at 16-40 mm); tensile 360 MPa is the lowest of the 360-510 MPa range for 3-100 mm. Eurocode 3 design values differ slightly by thickness band.

materials.name: Steel S355JR
materials.designation: Structural steel S355JR (EN 10025-2), hot rolled, thickness up to 16 mm
materials.notes: EN 10025-2 minimums: yield 355 MPa up to 16 mm thick (345 MPa at 16-40 mm, 335 MPa at 40-63 mm); tensile 470 MPa is the lowest of the 470-630 MPa range for 3-100 mm. Eurocode 3 (EN 1993-1-1 table 3.1) uses fu = 490 MPa up to 40 mm, so this library is the more conservative product-standard value.

materials.name: Stainless steel 304
materials.notes: Strengths are ASTM A240 minimums; cold-worked stock is stronger. Physical values are ASM (density 8000, E 193 GPa); EN 10088 sheets for 1.4301 use density about 7900 and E 200 GPa, and 1.4301 is only roughly 304.

materials.name: Stainless steel 316L
materials.notes: Strengths are ASTM A240 minimums. Density, E and specific heat are on the ASM 316L sheet; Poisson ratio, conductivity and expansion are widely quoted typical values that were not on that sheet. EN 1.4404 is only roughly 316L (EN sheets give E 200 GPa, expansion about 16.0e-6).

materials.name: Titanium Ti-6Al-4V
materials.notes: Strengths are ASTM B348 Grade 5 minimums for annealed bar (828 / 895 MPa); the ASM typical values are higher (about 880 / 950 MPa). Physical values are ASM typical values, checked against the ASM data sheet.

materials.name: PLA (3D printed, generic)
materials.designation: Polylactic acid, FDM printed, loaded along the layers
materials.notes: Prusament PLA datasheet values (printed specimens, 100% infill, flat): across-layer (Z) strength was 37.6 MPa in the 2018 datasheet and is lower than the in-plane value. Brand, print settings and moisture change these numbers; use your own filament's datasheet or test prints. Poisson ratio is a generic estimate, not from the datasheet. Creeps under steady load, softens around 55-60 C.

materials.name: PETG (3D printed, generic)
materials.designation: Glycol-modified PET, FDM printed, loaded along the layers
materials.notes: Prusament PETG datasheet values (printed specimens, 100% infill). Across the layers (Z) the datasheet gives only 30 MPa. Brand and print settings change these numbers. Poisson ratio is a generic estimate, not from the datasheet.

materials.name: ABS (3D printed, generic)
materials.designation: Acrylonitrile butadiene styrene, FDM printed, loaded along the layers
materials.notes: Bambu Lab ABS datasheet values (printed specimens, annealed and dried before testing, which probably makes them stronger than ordinary parts). Modulus is the across-layers value (2.96 GPa); the in-plane datasheet value is 3.8 GPa. Across the layers the tensile strength is 32 MPa. Poisson ratio is a generic estimate, not from the datasheet.

materials.name: ASA (3D printed, Bambu Lab)
materials.designation: Acrylonitrile styrene acrylate, FDM printed, loaded along the layers
materials.notes: Bambu Lab ASA datasheet V3.0 values (printed specimens, 100% infill, annealed and dried before testing). In-plane (X-Y) values: modulus 2.45 GPa, tensile 37 MPa. Across the layers (Z): modulus 2.12 GPa, tensile 31 MPa. The older V2.0 sheet gave 52 MPa in X-Y and 35 MPa in Z; the library uses V3.0. One brand; print settings and annealing change these numbers. Poisson ratio is a generic estimate, not from the datasheet. UV and weather resistant; heat deflection 92 C at 1.8 MPa.

materials.name: PAHT-CF (3D printed, Bambu Lab)
materials.designation: Carbon-fibre reinforced high-temperature nylon (PA12 and other long-chain PA), FDM printed, loaded along the layers
materials.notes: Bambu Lab PAHT-CF datasheet V3.0 values, DRY state (printed specimens, 100% infill, annealed and dried 80 C 12 h before testing). The sheet gives no conditioned (wet) tensile values; nylon absorbs water (0.88% saturated at 55% RH) and gets weaker and softer, so dry the part or expect less. In-plane (X-Y) values: modulus 3.86 GPa, tensile 92 MPa. Across the layers (Z): modulus 2.18 GPa, tensile 47 MPa, about half. The older V2.0 sheet gave 88 MPa X-Y and 64 MPa Z. Fibres make printed parts anisotropic, so the isotropic card overstates stiffness off the print plane. One brand. Poisson ratio is a generic estimate, not from the datasheet.

materials.name: Nylon PA12 (SLS printed, generic)
materials.notes: EOS PA 2200 datasheet values (laser sintered, dry; 930 kg/m3 is the part density, not the powder). Strength across the layers (Z) is 42 MPa. Poisson ratio is a generic estimate, not from the datasheet.
